_comment: Wiki filenames the wiki's own data gets wrong.
A row in the Items cargo table names the file its sprite lives in. Usually
that name is right. Occasionally the row and the file library disagree —
somebody typed the caption and somebody else uploaded the image — and the
fetcher asks for a file that does not exist. The record then keeps its drawn
glyph, which is correct behaviour and also a permanent hole for a sprite
The fetcher will not guess at this, and should not: `fetch.ts` says so in
as many words, because a plural that happens to be right once becomes a rule
that is wrong later. This file is the other thing — a person looked the file
up, confirmed it exists under a different name, and wrote both down. Every
entry needs a `checked` date and a reason, because an entry nobody can
re-verify is indistinguishable from the guess this file exists to avoid.
Keys are the wrong name exactly as the source states it, before
canonicalisation. Values are the name the wiki actually hosts.

corrections.reason: Items.icon for Rabbit Horn is plural; the uploaded file is singular. The plural title has never existed on the wiki.
